canonical_example.text: M. de Humboldt, socio estrangeiro, communicou a historia admiravel do volcão de Jorullo , que rompeo em 1759 no Mexico[…]
canonical_example.translation: Monsieur von Humboldt, a foreigner associate, communicated the admirable history of the Jorullo volcano, which erupted in 1759 in Mexico […]

examples.text: Na Villa de Ribeyra Grande foraõ ainda mais tremendos os ſucceſſos, porque como a ſerra, ou monte de Vulcaõ, que he o mayor de toda a Ilha, inclina mais para Ribeyra Grande, do que para Villa Franca, & deſte Vulcaõ he que queria ſahir o fogo[…]
examples.ref: 1717, Antonio Cordeyro, “Dos incendios que ſuccedèraõ à Peſte [On the fires that followed the plague]” (chapter XI), in Historia insulana das ilhas a Portugal sugeytas no Oceano Occidental [Insular history of the islands subjected to Portugal on the Western Ocean], livro 5, Lisbon: Antonio Pedrozo Galram, page 161, line 89:
examples.english: At the village of Ribeira Grande, success was even more tremendous, because since the sierra (or the volcano mount, which is the biggest one on the whole island) leans more toward Ribeira Grande than Vila Franca, and it was out of this volcano that fire wanted to come […]
examples.translation: At the village of Ribeira Grande, success was even more tremendous, because since the sierra (or the volcano mount, which is the biggest one on the whole island) leans more toward Ribeira Grande than Vila Franca, and it was out of this volcano that fire wanted to come […]
